Delhi Implements Winter Pollution Control Measures

Delhi authorities have introduced a series of measures to combat air pollution ahead of winter. These include a 50% work-from-home mandate for government employees, a doubling of parking charges, staggered office timings, and a ban on polluting vehicles. Efforts are also being made to enhance last-mile connectivity.
